field.label: Pipe
field.help: The Traffic Shaper pipe to impair. Traffic reaches it through the shaper's rules (Firewall > Shaper > Rules).

field.label: Latency (ms)
field.help: Added one-way delay in milliseconds. Leave empty to keep the pipe's own delay. Put the pipe on both directions to add it to the round trip twice.

field.label: Packet loss (%)
field.help: Share of packets dropped at random as they enter the pipe, e.g. 2.5 for 2.5 %.
